sources.title: Step 3.5 Flash model guide and named variants
sources.evidence: Shared specifications give sparse MoE, nominal 196B total and 11B active parameters. The variants section explicitly includes step-3.5-flash-2603, tuned from the base model for agent/coding use, with low/high reasoning effort. This supports family-level advertised figures, not an exact dated checkpoint count.

sources.title: Official model overview: exact Step 3.5 Flash 2603 card
sources.evidence: The exact 2603 card is in the text reasoning category, advertises 256K context, and describes retained reasoning and tool-calling capabilities with an optional low-reasoning mode. The adjacent Step 3.7 model adds native image/video understanding; those modalities do not apply to 2603.

sources.title: Step Plan supported reasoning API models
sources.evidence: Lists base Step 3.5 Flash and 2603 separately. The base row supplies 196B/11B sparse-MoE figures; the 2603 row describes optimization from that base and low reasoning. This is a trained variant, not merely a price or service tier. No exact 2603 checkpoint revision is identified.

sources.title: StepFun platform service terms, section 6
sources.evidence: StepFun and its providers retain rights in the services; users receive access/use rights, not ownership. Separate open-source terms apply only to relevant components. Supports a proprietary API-service classification, not an Apache-2.0 grant for an unlocated 2603 checkpoint.

sources.title: April 3, 2026 report of StepFun April 2 launch
sources.publisher: National Business Daily (每日经济新闻)
sources.evidence: Contemporaneous report explicitly says StepFun announced Step 3.5 Flash 2603 available to all Step Plan subscribers on April 2, 2026. This is secondary release-date evidence, not a technical-specification source. It describes developer availability rather than a later third-party endpoint listing.

sources.title: Step 3.5 Flash Series New Release
sources.publisher: John_Stepfun on DEV Community; affiliation not independently verified
sources.evidence: April 2 post says the exact 2603 model is available to Step Plan users and provides its identifier and low/high mode example. The author presents team testing, but the profile does not independently verify employment. Used only as corroboration, not treated as an authenticated developer announcement.

sources.title: StepFun official Hugging Face model inventory
sources.evidence: Accessed creator inventory includes original Step 3.5 Flash and its FP8, GGUF, base and midtrain variants, plus Step 3.7 Flash and Step 5 releases. No exact 2603 repository appears. Absence in this checked inventory does not prove that weights are closed.

sources.title: Exact dated-model repository search
sources.evidence: Exact-name repository search returned an empty array; creator-scoped 2603 search did too. No 2603 checkpoint was located for configuration, tensor-header or license verification. Search absence is not an affirmative closed-weights declaration.

sources.title: Original Step 3.5 Flash branches and tags
sources.evidence: Original repository has main at ab446a3de5e171ea341227e24bb1f090e1b771f7 and no tags. No 2603 ref establishes equivalence between the original public checkpoint and the dated API model.

sources.title: Original checkpoint history
sources.evidence: Original weight upload is February 1, 2026, commit 8fb8cbcf636ea69a69659210aca3227b97f26615. The accessed history does not identify a 2603 weight replacement. The baseline weight link therefore does not establish this dated model is downloadable; upload dates are not used as release dates.

sources.title: Original public Step 3.5 Flash model card
sources.evidence: Original public model card declares Apache-2.0 and discusses its architecture/MTP implementation, but does not identify 2603. Its exact checkpoint parameters, prediction-head count, context configuration and Apache grant are not transferred to the dated API variant.

sources.title: Step 3.5 Flash technical report
sources.evidence: Accessed original technical report; no exact 2603 identification found. Its original-model technical details do not establish a full parameter count or MTP layout for the later API variant.

sources.title: Later Step 3.7 Flash model card
sources.evidence: Checked later first-party card and comparison material for exact 2603 disclosures; none found. Its multimodal architecture, additional vision parameters and advertised counts are not substituted for 2603.

sources.title: Later Step 5 Preview model card
sources.evidence: Checked later first-party card and comparison material; it does not identify exact 2603 total/active counts or architecture changes. This check is bounded to the accessed materials, not a claim of exhaustive research.

name.note: Exact named variant; retain dated suffix.

developer.note: Official developer documentation identifies this model.

family.note: Normalized Step family; guide groups 2603 with Step 3.5 Flash.

release_date.note: Earliest explicit availability found is April 2, 2026 for Step Plan subscribers. Retain day precision, supported by contemporaneous press and a corroborating DEV post with unverified author affiliation. Do not infer March release from 2603, February availability from the base model, or current endpoint operation from documentation.

open_weights.note: Clear baseline true. No exact 2603 checkpoint or explicit weight-release statement was located. The linked February base checkpoint is insufficient evidence; absence from checked repositories is also insufficient to assert false.

license.note: Descriptive classification of the documented API service under StepFun terms. No exact 2603 weight-license grant was located; the original public checkpoint's Apache-2.0 license is not inherited. This classification does not resolve whether 2603 weights are publicly released elsewhere.

parameters_b.note: Nominal billions under shared developer specifications covering the named variant. No exact 2603 checkpoint sum or prediction-head accounting is claimed; later checked research supplies no variant-specific count.

active_parameters_b.note: Nominal activated billions under the same shared specification; not an independently measured serving-graph total or full MTP-inclusive count.

architecture.note: Shared sparse-MoE specification and explicit tuning lineage support this category; detailed dated serving architecture is not disclosed.

context_window.note: Exact model advertises 256K. Preserve decimal nominal expansion; do not borrow a 262144-token configuration from the original public checkpoint.

modalities.note: Exact variant appears as text reasoning. The later 3.7 image/video capabilities are distinct.

reasoning.note: Exact variant supports low and high reasoning_effort.

tool_call.note: Exact variant explicitly retains tool calling.

description.value: Agent-tuned text model in the Step 3.5 Flash family, with low/high reasoning modes and tool calling.
description.note: Replace unsupported multimodal wording with documented text/agent tuning and modes.

sources.label: StepFun model guide and named variants
Original Step 3.5 Flash checkpoint; not verified as 2603

patch.notes: 196B total and 11B active are nominal figures from StepFun's shared model guide listing 2603 as a tuned variant; they are not an exact dated-checkpoint or full-MTP count. Public weights for 2603 are unverified: the original Step 3.5 Flash checkpoint does not establish equivalence. Proprietary describes the API terms, not a discovered weight license. Context is advertised as 256K. April 2, 2026 availability is corroborated by contemporaneous press; no authenticated primary release announcement was verified.

summary: Audited all 14 fields. Add developer-advertised nominal 196B/11B and sparse MoE with explicit shared-guide scope. Clear unsupported open-weights claim, classify the documented API terms as proprietary, and remove unsupported multimodal description. Retain April 2 availability with secondary-source qualification, text modalities, nominal 256K context, reasoning and tools. Exact 2603 checkpoint/count/MTP structure and weight-release status remain unresolved; original Step 3.5 and later 3.7/5 specifications are not substituted.
